name: npm-on-path
label: npm
description: npm is on the PATH and runnable.

commands.win32: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $arch = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') { 'arm64' } else { 'x64' }; $v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | ForEach-Object { $_ } | Where-Object { $_.lts } | Select-Object -First 1).version; $root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs'; $name = "node-$v-win-$arch"; $dir = Join-Path $root $name; if (-not ((Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'node.exe')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'npm.cmd')))) { $zipName = "$name.zip"; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP $zipName; Invoke-WebRequest "https://nodejs.org/dist/$v/$zipName" -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; $sums = (Invoke-WebRequest "https://nodejs.org/dist/$v/SHASUMS256.txt" -UseBasicParsing).Content; if ($sums -is [byte[]]) { $sums = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($sums) }; $want = [regex]::Match([string]$sums, '(?m)^([0-9a-f]{64})\s+' + [regex]::Escape($zipName) + '\s*$').Groups[1].Value; $got = (Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); if ((-not $want) -or ($got -ne $want)) { Remove-Item $zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw "SHA256 mismatch for $zipName" }; if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive $zip $root -Force; Remove-Item $zip -Force }; $user = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User'); if (-not (("$user" -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -and ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_).TrimEnd('\') -ieq $dir) })) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($dir + ';' + $user).TrimEnd(';'), 'User') }
